comment: Detection rules. weight = how strongly the surface form reads as evidence of the named signal. information_content = how much real information NED's own scoring model thinks the evidence actually carries (deliberately lower than weight for weakly-informative signals). amplified_interpretation is the NEA's deliberately irrational reading; NED always prints it next to a reality check. Nothing here is a claim about anyone's feelings.
